name: Marketing Blaster Pricing Sheet Sync | Vhea

nodes.name: Every 12 hours (safety net)
nodes.notes: Fallback only. The real trigger is the webhook below, fired by api/price-refresh.js at the end of a run so the sheet moves on exactly the AI-828 cadence rather than near it. This exists so the sheet still refreshes if that call is ever removed or fails.

nodes.name: Pricing Sheet Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by api/price-refresh.js after each run. Set PRICING_SHEET_WEBHOOK_URL in Vercel to this node's Production URL.

nodes.name: Get Freshness Rules
nodes.notes:
Thresholds read live, not hardcoded, so the sheet cannot disagree with the Ticket Prices tab. Amber is the refresh cutoff, red is twice it (a cycle genuinely missed).

RPC, NOT the table. Reading /rest/v1/decider_rules directly returns [] under the anon key — RLS filters it silently, HTTP 200, no error — so the sheet would have been built on default thresholds without anything failing. get_decider_rules is security definer and works for either key.

nodes.name: Get Events
nodes.notes:
PAGED ON PURPOSE. PostgREST caps a response at 1,000 rows and events_master holds ~2,449, so an unpaged read would silently write under half the table and look complete. Stops when a short page comes back.

ORDERED BY A UNIQUE KEY. event_date alone is not unique — hundreds of games share a date — and offset paging over a non-deterministic sort returns some rows twice and skips others. Measured: ordering by event_date alone produced 2,449 rows containing only 2,448 distinct events. id.asc breaks the tie so every page is stable.

nodes.name: Build Sheet Rows
nodes.notes: Throws rather than writing nothing: an empty result means the read failed, and silently clearing the sheet would look like 'there are no prices'.

nodes.name: Write Pricing Sheet
nodes.notes:
appendOrUpdate matched on event_id — that is what makes "no duplicate event rows" structural
rather than something the sync has to police. Output only: nothing here ever reads the sheet
back, so a human edit is overwritten on the next run rather than flowing anywhere.

TWO THINGS THE IMPORT DOES NOT CARRY, both of which silently produce an EMPTY sheet:

1. Column to Match On must be set to event_id. n8n dropped matchingColumns on import; with
   none set, appendOrUpdate cannot decide update-vs-append and writes nothing.

2. The sheet needs a header row before the first run. autoMapInputData maps incoming field
   names onto EXISTING columns by name, so a blank sheet has nothing to map onto. Paste these
   22 headers into row 1 of the Pricing Tab:
   event_id, external_id, event_date, kickoff_et, matchup, sport, league, market, state_code,
   venue, get_in_price_usd, seats_basis, source, source_raw, listing_url, last_refreshed_et,
   hours_since_refresh, freshness, amber_after_hours, red_after_hours, days_until, synced_at_utc
